verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a Git forge, but the evidence shows no scheduling capability in GitCafe itself. Webhooks are one-off, event-triggered callbacks rather than recurring schedules. CI runs come from external systems (Buildkite, GitHub Actions) whose results GitCafe only displays as checks, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
